text:
Alex: Heads-up: planning a small eu-west routing shift tomorrow 2025-05-02 14:00 UTC. 10% traffic to new edge policy for 30m, then evaluate.
Maya: I'm available and will own smoke checks + rollback if needed.
Li: I'll handle DNS TTL changes. Plan: lower to 30s at 13:45 UTC, do the weight update at 14:00, then restore TTL after stable.
Dinesh: Which policy variant are we testing? Any model/instance changes to be aware of?
Alex: Canary policy = edge-policy-rw-v2 (quantized), fallback = edge-policy-rw-v2-std. No infra changes, just routing weights. Autoscaler stays as-is.
Sara: Can someone paste the quick smoke checklist? I'll run the prompt set and synthetic load.
Alex: Smoke checklist (short):
- preflight: `cfg diff` + dry-run
- TTL -> 30s
- apply weight +10% to eu-west
- monitor first 15m: p95 latency, 5xx rate, tail cpu
- run prompt pack (10 queries / route)
- rollback if 5xx > 1% or p95 > 2x baseline
Maya: Ack. I'll kick off monitoring dashboards at T+0 and post short status updates.
Li: DNS commands I'll run (manual zone update):
```
# verify
dig @ns1.redwood-internal redwood-eu A +short
# then update weights in the zone file via console
```
Dinesh: Who has permission to do the actual weight update and rollback? Clarifying for runbook.
Alex: Li will update DNS weight, Maya can revert routing policy in the orchestrator, Dinesh can trigger model fallback if needed. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/edge-rollout
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: job_id=job-1872349200, target=eu-west, delta=+10%, exec_time=2025-05-02T14:00:00Z
Sara: I'll start synthetic prompt run at 14:05 and post pass/fail.
Maya: Preflight done: `cfg diff` clean, dry-run ok. Lowering TTL at 13:45 UTC.
Li: TTL lowered to 30s (13:46 UTC). Confirmed propagation to ns1/ns2 :white_check_mark:
Alex: Applying +10% weight now (14:00). Hold for 15m.
Maya: Monitoring: p95=118ms (baseline 120ms), 5xx=0.15% at 14:10 :thumbsup:
Sara: Prompt pack run complete at 14:12 — outputs look normal, latency within SLA.
Dinesh: Noted a small spike at 14:30 (brief), traced to a batch job overlap not routing change. No correlation with rollout.
Alex: Good. Increasing to 30% at 14:45 if metrics stay green.
Maya: All green at 14:40. Proceeding with 30% increase.
deploy-bot: Job completed: job_id=job-1872349200 status=success
Li: Restoring TTL to 300s at 15:30 UTC.
Alex: Final check — p95 steady, error-rate <0.2%. No rollback required. Thanks team! :tada:
Maya: Nice and smooth. Filing short post-rollout note in the weekly ops doc.
Sara: Adding the prompt run artifacts to the ticket.
Dinesh: Logging the batch-job cause for follow-up, not a rollout action item.
Alex: Closing thread, will schedule canary for other regions next week.
